Volume 2, page 336.
The report does not name the imam. The Shia corpus names him, in reports that fuse the count, the lineage, and the prayer behind him.

Ibn Abbas's report, Bihar al-Anwar, vol. 51, p. 73, from Kamal al-Din 12 - إكمال الدين : ابن مسرور ، عن ابن عامر ، عن المعلى ، عن جعفر بن سليمان ، عن عبد الله بن الحكم ، عن أبيه ، عن سعيد بن جبير ، عن ابن عباس قال : قال رسول الله ﵌ : إن خلفائي وأوصيائي وحجج الله على الخلق بعدي اثنا عشر أولهم أخي وآخرهم ولدي وقيل : يا رسول الله ﵌ ومن أخوك ؟ قال : علي بن أبي طالب قيل فمن ولدك ؟ قال : المهدي يملاها قسطا وعدلا كما ملئت جورا وظلما والذي بعثني بالحق نبيا لو لم يبق من الدنيا إلا يوم واحد لأطال الله ذلك اليوم حتى يخرج فيه ولدي المهدي فينزل روح الله عيسى بن مريم ﵇ فيصلي خلفه وتشرق الأرض بنور ربها ويبلغ سلطانه المشرق والمغرب . Kamal al-Din. Ibn Masrur, from Ibn Amir, from al-Mualla, from Jafar ibn Sulayman, from Abd Allah ibn al-Hakam, from his father, from Said ibn Jubayr, from Ibn Abbas, who said, "The Messenger of Allah said, 'My successors, my trustees, and Allah's proofs over creation after me are twelve. The first of them is my brother and the last of them is my son.'" It was said, "Messenger of Allah, who is your brother?" He said, "Ali ibn Abi Talib." It was said, "Then who is your son?" He said, "The Mahdi. He will fill it with equity and justice as it has been filled with tyranny and oppression. By Him who sent me with the truth as a prophet, if only one day remained of the world, Allah would lengthen that day until my son, the Mahdi, emerges in it. Then Jesus son of Mary, the Spirit of Allah, will descend and pray behind him. The earth will shine with the light of its Lord, and his authority will reach the east and the west."

Twelve successors, the first Ali ﵇, the last the Mahdi, and then Isa ﵇ son of Mary, the Spirit of God, descends and prays behind him, and the earth shines with the light of its Lord, and his authority reaches east and west. Imam al-Rida ﵇ states it in al-Ma'mun's own assembly.

Imam al-Rida, Uyun Akhbar al-Rida, vol. 2, p. 218 الرجعة فقال الرضا ﵇ : إنها لحق قد كانت في الأمم السالفة ونطق به القرآن وقد قال رسول الله (ص) يكون في هذه الأمة كل ما كان في الأمم السالفة حذو النعل بالنعل والقذة بالقذة (1) قال ﵇ : إذا خرج المهدي من ولدي نزل عيسى بن مريم ﵇ فصلى خلفه وقال ﵇ : إن الاسلام بدأ غريبا وسيعود غريبا فطوبى للغرباء قيل : يا رسول الله ثم يكون ماذا ؟ قال ثم يرجع الحق إلى أهله فقال المأمون يا أبا الحسن فما تقول في القائلين بالتناسخ ؟ فقال الرضا ﵇ : من قال بالتناسخ فهو كافر بالله العظيم مكذب بالجنة والنار قال المأمون : ما تقول في المسوخ ؟ قال الرضا ﵇ : أولئك قوم غضب الله عليهم فمسخهم فعاشوا ثلاثة أيام ثم ماتوا ولم يتناسلوا فما يوجد في الدنيا من القردة والخنازير وغير ذلك مما وقع عليهم أسم المسوخية فهو مثل ما لا يحل أكلها والانتفاع بها قال المأمون : لا أبقاني الله بعدك يا أبا الحسن فوالله ما يوجد العلم الصحيح إلا عند أهل البيت وإليك انتهت علوم آبائك فجزاك الله عن الاسلام وأهله خيرا قال الحسن بن جهم : فلما قام الرضا ﵇ تبعته فانصرف إلى منزله فدخلت عليه وقلت له : يا بن رسول الله الحمد لله الذي وهب من جميل رأي أمير المؤمنين ﵇ ما حمله ما أرى من إكرامه لك وقبوله لقولك [He asked about] the return, and al-Rida said, “It is true. It occurred among the former communities, the Quran has spoken of it, and the Messenger of God said, ‘Everything that occurred among the former communities will occur in this community, exactly as one shoe matches the other and one arrow feather matches the other.’” He said, “When the Mahdi from among my descendants emerges, Jesus son of Mary will descend and pray behind him.” He said, “Islam began as something strange, and it will return as something strange. Blessed are the strangers.” It was said, “Messenger of God, then what will happen?” He said, “Then the truth will return to those entitled to it.” Al-Ma'mun said, “Abu al-Hasan, what do you say about those who hold to transmigration?” Al-Rida said, “Whoever holds to transmigration disbelieves in God the Almighty and denies Paradise and the Fire.” Al-Ma'mun said, “What do you say about those who were transformed?” Al-Rida said, “They were people with whom God was angry, so He transformed them. They lived for three days, then died, and did not reproduce. Thus, the monkeys, pigs, and other creatures found in the world that bear the name of those transformed are like things whose eating and use are not permitted.” Al-Ma'mun said, “May God not keep me alive after you, Abu al-Hasan. By God, sound knowledge is found only with the People of the House, and the knowledge of your forefathers has come to you. May God reward you well on behalf of Islam and its people.” Al-Hasan ibn Jahm said, “When al-Rida rose, I followed him. He returned to his house, and I entered upon him and said, ‘Son of the Messenger of God, praise be to God, who granted the Commander of the Faithful such sound judgment as led him to what I see of his honoring you and accepting your words.’”
Al-Kafi carries it in Gabriel's words to the Prophet ﷺ.

Gabriel's words to the Prophet, al-Kafi, vol. 8, p. 74, hadith 10 الوصيين والحسن والحسين سبطاك سيد الأسباط وحمزة عمك سيد الشهداء وجعفر ابن عمك الطيار في الجنة يطير مع الملائكة حيث يشاء ومنكم القائم يصلي عيسى بن مريم خلفه إذا أهبطه الله إلى الأرض من ذرية علي وفاطمة من ولد الحسين (﵈) . the trustees, and Hasan and Husayn, your two grandsons, the masters of the grandsons. Hamza, your uncle, is the master of the martyrs. Jafar, your cousin, is the one who flies in Paradise with the angels wherever he wishes. From among you is the Qa'im, behind whom Isa ibn Maryam will pray when God sends him down to the earth. He is from the descendants of Ali and Fatima, from the line of al-Husayn.

Imam al-Hasan, Ithbat al-Hudat, vol. 5, p. 81, report 118 118 - وقال : حدثنا المظفر بن جعفر العلوي عن جعفر بن محمّد بن مسعود عن أبيه عن جبرئيل بن أحمد عن موسى بن جعفر البغدادي عن الحسن بن محمّد الصيرفي عن حنان بن سدير عن أبيه عن أبي سعيد عقيصا عن الحسن بن علي ﵇ في حديث قال : أما علمتم أنه ما منا أحد إلا وتقع في عنقه بيعة لطاغية زمانه إلا القائم الذي يصلّي عيسى بن مريم خلفه ، وإن اللّه ﷿ يخفي ولادته ويغيب شخصه لئلا يكون لأحد في عنقه بيعة إذا خرج ذلك التاسع من ولد أخي الحسين ابن سيدة النساء يطيل اللّه عمره في غيبته ثم يظهره بقدرته في صورة شاب ابن دون أربعين سنة ليعلم أن اللّه على كل شيء قدير (4) . He said, "Al-Muzaffar ibn Jafar al-Alawi narrated to us, from Jafar ibn Muhammad ibn Masud, from his father, from Jibril ibn Ahmad, from Musa ibn Jafar al-Baghdadi, from al-Hasan ibn Muhammad al-Sayrafi, from Hannan ibn Sudayr, from his father, from Abu Said Uqaysa, from al-Hasan ibn Ali, in a report in which he said, 'Do you not know that there is none of us except that allegiance to the tyrant of his time falls upon his neck, except the Qa'im, behind whom Jesus son of Mary will pray? Allah conceals his birth and hides his person so that no one's allegiance may be upon his neck when he emerges. That ninth one from the descendants of my brother al-Husayn, son of the Lady of Women, Allah will prolong his life during his occultation, then He will manifest him by His power in the form of a young man under forty years old, so that it may be known that Allah has power over all things.'"

Every one of us bears allegiance to the tyrant of his age on his neck, except the Qa'im, behind whom Isa ﵇ son of Mary will pray. God hides his birth and conceals his person so that no allegiance binds him when he rises.

The Davidic lineage of these kings needs its own word, because the Prophet's ﷺ house is not David's line. The framework already distinguishes the returning Isa ﵇, the son of David, who confirms the truth, from the divinely guided ruler of the final order, and it places the Davidic king inside the Mahdi's kingdom rather than on its throne. A Christian who insists the Davidic king must himself reign has the reports of both traditions to weigh, which give the throne to a man from the Prophet's ﷺ house while Isa ﵇ stands behind him in prayer. The Bible's king who reigns, judges, fights, and fills the earth with justice needs a reign, a judgment, a war, and a transformation. The Gospels record that Isa קּ declined the kingdom before Pilate.
What the case establishes and what it does not

Source: Christian holders. Pius XII, Munificentissimus Deus 27 (1950) for the Marian reading; Catholic Encyclopedia, "Apocalypse" (1907) for the Church and Israel readings and the Genesis 37 background; Ilzam al-Nasib, vol. 1, p. 130, for the church reading known to Muslim polemic Source: Islamic exhibits quoted above, Shia and Sunni, cited in their sections Claim: the compared offices, woman, twelve, and reigning king, and who fills them

Three readings now stand side by side. The Christian readings assign the woman to Mary, to the Church, or to Israel, and assign the reigning king to a future advent of Jesus ﵇. The reading documented above assigns the woman's sun, moon, and twelve stars to the figures the Islamic corpus itself names, the twelve princes of Ishmael to the twelve Imams ﵈, and the reigning king to the Mahdi with Isa ﵇ behind him.

On textual fidelity, the comparison runs this way. The Islamic corpus transmits each element, the sun as the Prophet ﷺ and the moon as Ali ﵇ in the exegesis of Qur'an 91, the nine shining stars as the Imams from al-Husayn's line in the Salman report, the count of twelve in the Tablet and its family of reports, and the justice-filling ruler from Fatimah's ﵍ line. The connection of those fixed elements to the Bible's sign is a modern inference, and each step above has been labeled where inference begins. The Christian readings of the same sign are also assignments, older and internally divided, resting on the authority the reader grants the church. Neither side can prove its assignment from the text alone, because the text names no one.

What the case establishes is narrower and firmer. If the promised Messiah has already come and completed his messianic work, where are the outcomes the prophets promised, the universal law, the peace among nations, the destroyed oppressor kingdoms, the gathered and secure Israel, the worldwide justice? A Christian must answer that they remain future. The question left standing is who fills those offices. The Sunni strand of the reports leaves him unnamed at the descent, and the Imami strand names his line from the children of Fatimah. The Islamic corpus is the one that names him.
Final Verdict

Final Verdict The woman of Revelation 12 is a sign of a sun, a moon, and twelve stars around one woman. The Qur'an swears by the sun and the moon, and the Imams named them the Prophet ﷺ and Ali ﵇. Both schools count twelve from Quraysh, and the Imami reports name all twelve, first Ali קּ and last the Mahdi, eleven of them Fatimah's כֿ descendants. Genesis promises twelve princes from Ishmael, and the line of Ishmael's greatest descendant carried exactly that number of guides. The prophets promise a reigning king of worldwide justice, and the reports of both traditions describe him from the Prophet's ﷺ progeny, with Isa ﵇ returned and praying behind him. The Bible supplies the job description. The Islamic corpus supplies the names. The connection between them is a reading, and each step has been marked where inference begins.

n0012.caption: Revelation 12:1-2, Textus Receptus, Van Dyck, King James Version
paragraphs: και σημειον μεγα ωφθη εν τω ουρανω γυνη περιβεβλημενη τον ηλιον και η σεληνη υποκατω των ποδων αυτης και επι της κεφαλης αυτης στεφανος αστερων δωδεκα και εν γαστρι εχουσα κραζει ωδινουσα και βασανιζομενη τεκειν
1 وظهرت آية عظيمة في السماء امرأته متسربلة بالشمس والقمر تحت رجليها وعلى رأسها إكليل من اثني عشر كوكبا . 2 وهي حبلى تصرخ متمخضة ومتوجعة لتلد .

kai sēmeion mega ōphthē en tō ouranō, gunē peribeblēmenē ton hēlion, kai hē selēnē hupokatō tōn podōn autēs, kai epi tēs kephalēs autēs stephanos asterōn dōdeka, kai en gastri echousa kraizei, ōdinousa kai basanizomenē tekein.

"And there appeared a great wonder in heaven; a woman clothed with the sun, and the moon under her feet, and upon her head a crown of twelve stars: And she being with child cried, travailing in birth, and pained to be delivered."

n0014.caption: Revelation 12:5, Textus Receptus, Van Dyck, King James Version

5 فولدت ابنا ذكرا عتيدا أن يرعى جميع الأمم بعصا من حديد . واختطف ولدها إلى الله وإلى عرشه .
kai eteken huion arrena, hos mellei poimainein panta ta ethnē en hrabdō sidērā, kai hērpasthē to teknon autēs pros ton theon kai ton thronon autou.
"And she brought forth a man child, who was to rule all nations with a rod of iron: and her child was caught up unto God, and to his throne."

n0015.caption: Revelation 12:17, Textus Receptus, Van Dyck, King James Version
paragraphs: και ωργισθη ο δρακων επι τη γυναικι και απηλθεν ποιησαι πολεμον μετα των λοιπων του σπερματος αυτης των τηρουντων τας εντολας του θεου και εχοντων την μαρτυριαν του ιησου χριστου
17 فغضب التنين على المرأة وذهب ليصنع حربا مع باقي نسلها الذين يحفظون وصايا الله وعندهم شهادة يسوع المسيح
kai ōrgisthē ho drakōn epi tē gunaiki, kai apēlthen poiēsai polemon meta tōn loipōn tou spermatos autēs, tōn tērountōn tas entolas tou theou kai echontōn tēn marturian Iēsou christou.
"And the dragon was wroth with the woman, and went to make war with the remnant of her seed, which keep the commandments of God, and have the testimony of Jesus Christ."

n0022.caption: Qur'an 91:1-4, as cited in Ta'wil al-Ayat, vol. 2, p. 367
paragraphs: قال الله تعالى : بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم والشمس وضحاها (1) والقمر إذا تلاها (2) والنهار إذا جلاها (3) والليل إذا يغشاها (4)
Bismi llahi r-rahmani r-rahim. Wa-sh-shamsi wa-duhaha, wa-l-qamari idha talaha, wa-n-nahari idha jallaha, wa-l-layli idha yaghshaha.

God, Most High, said, "In the name of God, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful. By the sun and its morning brightness (1), and by the moon when it follows it (2), and by the day when it reveals it (3), and by the night when it covers it (4)."

n0024.caption: Imam al-Sadiq, Tafsir al-Qummi, vol. 2, p. 424
paragraphs: سورة الشمس مكية آياتها خمس عشرة (بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم والشمس وضحاها) قال : أخبرني أبي عن سليمان الديلمي عن أبي بصير عن أبي عبد الله ﵇ قال : سألته عن قول الله ﷿ والشمس وضحاها ، قال : الشمس رسول الله ﵌ أوضح الله به للناس دينهم قلت : (والقمر إذا تلاها) قال ذلك أمير المؤمنين (ع) قلت : (والليل إذا يغشاها) قال : ذلك أئمة الجور الذين استبدوا للامر دون آل رسول الله ﵌ وجلسوا مجلسا كان آل رسول الله ﵌ أولى به منهم ، فغشوا دين رسول الله ﵌ بالظلم والجور وهو قوله : والليل إذا يغشاها ، قال : يغشى ظلمهم ضوء النهار ، قلت : (والنهار إذا جلاها) قال : ذلك الامام من ذرية فاطمة ﵍ يسئل عن دين رسول الله فيجلى لمن يسأله ،
Surat al-Shams is Meccan. Its verses are fifteen.
In the name of God, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful. "By the sun and its morning brightness."

He said, "My father informed me from Sulayman al-Daylami, from Abu Basir, from Abu Abd Allah, who said, 'I asked him about the saying of God, "By the sun and its morning brightness." He said, "The sun is the Messenger of God. Through him God made His religion clear to the people."
I said, "And the moon when it follows it."
He said, "That is the Commander of the Faithful."
I said, "And the night when it covers it."

He said, "Those are the imams of tyranny who seized authority apart from the family of the Messenger of God and occupied a position to which the family of the Messenger of God had a greater right than they did. They covered the religion of the Messenger of God with wrongdoing and tyranny. This is His saying, 'And the night when it covers it.' Their wrongdoing covers the light of day."
I said, "And the day when it makes it clear."
He said, "That is the imam from the descendants of Fatimah. He is asked about the religion of the Messenger of God, and he makes it clear for whoever asks him.'"

n0026.caption: Al-Husayn, Tafsir Furat al-Kufi, p. 563, report 721
paragraphs: 721 - 3 فرات قال : حدثني علي بن محمد بن عمر الزهري معنعنا : عن أبي جعفر ﵇ قال : قال الحارث [بن عبد الله] الأعور للحسين ﵇ : يا ابن رسول الله جعلت فداك أخبرني عن قول الله في كتابه : (والشمس وضحاها) قال : ويحك يا حارث ذلك محمد رسول الله ﵌ . قال : قلت : جعلت فداك : قوله : (والقمر إذا تلاها) قال : ذلك أمير المؤمنين علي بن أبي طالب ﵇ يتلو محمدا ﵌ . قال : قلت : (والنهار إذا جلاها) قال : ذلك القائم من آل محمد ﵌ يملأ الأرض عدلا وقسطا .

Furat said, "Ali ibn Muhammad ibn Umar al-Zuhri narrated to me, with a chain of transmission, from Abu Jafar, who said, 'Al-Harith ibn Abd Allah al-Awar said to al-Husayn, "O son of the Messenger of Allah, may I be made your ransom, tell me about God's saying in His Book, 'By the sun and its brightness.'"
He said, "Woe to you, Harith. That is Muhammad, the Messenger of God."
He said, "I said, 'May I be made your ransom. His saying, 'And by the moon when it follows it.'"
He said, "That is the Commander of the Faithful, Ali ibn Abi Talib, following Muhammad."
He said, "I said, 'And by the day when it reveals it.'"
He said, "That is the Qa'im from the family of Muhammad. He will fill the earth with justice and equity."'"

n0028.caption: Imam al-Sadiq, Ta'wil al-Ayat, vol. 2, pp. 367-368, minority channel
paragraphs: لهذه تأويل ظاهر وباطن : فالظاهر ظاهر ، وأما الباطن فهو : 1 - ما رواه علي بن محمد ، عن أبي جميلة ، عن الحلبي . ورواه (أيضا) (1) علي بن الحكم ، عن أبان بن عثمان ، عن الفضل بن العباس عن أبي عبد الله ﵇ (أنه) (2) قال (والشمس وضحاها) الشمس : أمير المؤمنين ﵇ " وضحاها " قيام القائم (3) ﵇ (لان الله سبحانه قال (وأن يحشر الناس ضحى) (4) . (والقمر إذا تلاها) الحسن والحسين ﵉ . (والنهار إذا جلاها) هو قيام القائم ﵇ . (والليل إذا يغشاها) حبتر (ودولته قد غشى) (5) عليه الحق . وأما قوله (والسماء وما بناها) قال : هو محمد - عليه وآله السلام - هو السماء الذي يسموا إليه الخلف في العلم .
This has an outward interpretation and an inward interpretation. The outward is outward. As for the inward interpretation, it is as follows.

Ali ibn Muhammad narrated from Abu Jamilah, from al-Halabi. Ali ibn al-Hakam also narrated it from Aban ibn Uthman, from al-Fadl ibn al-Abbas, from Abu Abd Allah, who said, "By the sun and its morning brightness. The sun is the Commander of the Faithful. Its morning brightness is the rising of the Qa'im, because God, exalted is He, said, 'And that the people will be gathered in the morning.' And the moon when it follows it refers to Hasan and Husayn."
"And the day when it reveals it" is the rising of the Qa'im.
"And the night when it covers it" is Habtar, and his rule has covered the truth.
As for His saying, "And the heaven and He who built it," he said, "It is Muhammad. He is the heaven to which successors ascend in knowledge."

n0032.caption: The Prophet, Ma'ani al-Akhbar, pp. 208-209, with three chains, p. 208
paragraphs: (باب) (معنى الشمس والقمر والزهرة والفرقدين) 1 - حدثنا أبو الحسن محمد بن عمر [و] بن علي بن عبد الله البصري ، قال : حدثنا أبو بكر عبد الله بن علي الكرخي ، قال : حدثنا أبو بكر محمد بن عبد الله ، قال : حدثنا أبي قال : حدثنا عبد الرزاق الصنعاني ، قال : حدثنا معمر ، عن الزهري ، عن أنس بن مالك قال : صلى رسول الله ﵌ صلاة الفجر ، فلما انفتل من صلاته أقبل علينا بوجهه الكريم على الله ﷿ ثم قال : معاشر الناس من افتقد الشمس فليستمسك بالقمر ، ومن افتقد القمر فليستمسك بالزهرة ، فمن افتقد الزهرة فليستمسك (2) بالفرقدين . ثم قال رسول الله ﵌ : أنا الشمس ، وعلي القمر ، وفاطمة الزهرة ، والحسن والحسين الفرقدان . وكتاب الله لا يفترقان حتى يردا علي الحوض . - 2 حدثنا أبو الحسن محمد بن عمر [و] البصري ، قال : حدثنا أبو القاسم نصر بن الحسين الصفار النهاوندي بها ، قال : حدثنا أبو الفرج أحمد بن محمد بن خوزي السامري ، قال : حدثنا أبو بكر القاسم بن إبراهيم القنطري ، قال : حدثنا إبراهيم بن خالد الحلواني ، قال حدثنا محمد بن خلف العسقلاني ، قال : حدثنا محمد بن السري ، عن محمد بن المنكدر ، عن جابر بن عبد الله ، قال . قال رسول الله ﵌ : اقتدوا بالشمس فإذا غابت الشمس فاقتدوا
Chapter on the meaning of the sun, the moon, Venus, and the two Farqads

Abu al-Hasan Muhammad ibn Umar ibn Ali ibn Abd Allah al-Basri narrated to us. He said that Abu Bakr Abd Allah ibn Ali al-Karkhi narrated to us. He said that Abu Bakr Muhammad ibn Abd Allah narrated to us. He said that his father narrated to us. He said that Abd al-Razzaq al-San'ani narrated to us from Ma'mar, from al-Zuhri, from Anas ibn Malik, who said

The Messenger of God performed the dawn prayer. When he had turned away after his prayer, he turned toward us with his noble face, God exalted be He, and said, "People, whoever loses the sun should hold fast to the moon. Whoever loses the moon should hold fast to Venus. Whoever loses Venus should hold fast to the two Farqads."

Then the Messenger of God said, "I am the sun, Ali is the moon, Fatima is Venus, and Hasan and Husayn are the two Farqads. They and the Book of God will not separate until they come to me at the Pool."

Abu al-Hasan Muhammad ibn Umar al-Basri narrated to us. He said that Abu al-Qasim Nasr ibn al-Husayn al-Saffar al-Nahawandi narrated to us there. He said that Abu al-Faraj Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khuwayzi al-Samiri narrated to us. He said that Abu Bakr al-Qasim ibn Ibrahim al-Qantari narrated to us. He said that Ibrahim ibn Khalid al-Hulwani narrated to us. He said that Muhammad ibn Khalaf al-Asqalani narrated to us. He said that Muhammad ibn al-Sari narrated to us from Muhammad ibn al-Munkadir, from Jabir ibn Abd Allah, who said
The Messenger of God said, "Follow the sun. When the sun sets, follow"

n0033.caption: The Prophet, Ma'ani al-Akhbar, pp. 208-209, with three chains, continued, p. 209
paragraphs: بالقمر ، فإذا غاب القمر فاقتدوا بالزهرة فإذا غابت الزهرة فاقتدوا بالفرقدين فقالوا : يا رسول الله فما الشمس ؟ وما القمر ؟ وما الزهرة ؟ وما الفرقدان ؟ فقال : أنا الشمس ، وعلي القمر ، والزهرة فاطمة ، والفرقدان الحسن والحسين

by the moon. When the moon disappears, follow Venus. When Venus disappears, follow the two Farqad stars." They said, "Messenger of God, what are the sun, the moon, Venus, and the two Farqad stars?" He said, "I am the sun, Ali is the moon, Venus is Fatimah, and the two Farqad stars are Hasan and Husayn."

n0035.caption: The Prophet, Nuzhat al-Majalis, vol. 2, p. 315, citing al-Thalabi's Ara'is
paragraphs: وفي حديث آخر : «من افتقد الشمس فليتمسك بالقمر ومن افتقد القمر فليتمسك بالزهرة ومن افتقد الزهرة فليتمسك بالفرقدين فسئل عن ذلك فقال : أنا الشمس وعلي القمر والزهرة فاطمة والفرقدان الحسن والحسين ﵃» ذكره في العرائس
In another report, "Whoever loses the sun should hold fast to the moon. Whoever loses the moon should hold fast to Venus. Whoever loses Venus should hold fast to the two Farqads."
He was asked about this and said, "I am the sun, Ali is the moon, Venus is Fatimah, and the two Farqads are Hasan and Husayn."
He mentioned it in al-Ara'is.

n0037.caption: The Prophet, Kifayat al-Athar, pp. 65-66, Salman's report, p. 65
paragraphs: معاشر الناس من افتقد الشمس فليتمسك بالقمر ، ومن افتقد القمر فليتمسك بالفرقدين ، فإذا فقدتم الفرقدين فتمسكوا بالنجوم الزاهرة بعدي ، أقول قولي هذا وأستغفر الله لي ولكم . قال : فلما نزل عن المنبر ﵌ تبعته حتى دخل بيت عائشة ، فدخلت إليه وقلت : بأبي أنت وأمي يا رسول الله سمعتك تقول " إذا افتقدتم الشمس فتمسكوا بالقمر ، وإذا افتقدتم القمر فتمسكوا بالفرقدين ، وإذا افتقدتم الفرقدين فتمسكوا بالنجوم الزاهرة " فما الشمس وما القمر وما الفرقدان وما النجوم الزاهرة ؟ فقال : [أنا الشمس (2) وعلي القمر والحسن والحسين الفرقدان ، فإذا افتقدتموني فتمسكوا بعلي بعدي ، وإذا افتقدتموه فتمسكوا بالحسن والحسين] ، وأما النجوم الزاهرة فهم الأئمة (3) التسعة (4)

"People, whoever loses the sun, let him hold fast to the moon. Whoever loses the moon, let him hold fast to the two Farqads. When you lose the two Farqads, hold fast after me to the shining stars. I say these words of mine and ask God to forgive me and you."

He said, "When he came down from the pulpit, I followed him until he entered the house of Aisha. I entered upon him and said, 'May my father and mother be sacrificed for you, O Messenger of God. I heard you say, "When you lose the sun, hold fast to the moon. When you lose the moon, hold fast to the two Farqads. When you lose the two Farqads, hold fast to the shining stars." What are the sun, the moon, the two Farqads, and the shining stars?'

He said, 'I am the sun, Ali is the moon, and Hasan and Husayn are the two Farqads. When you lose me, hold fast after me to Ali. When you lose him, hold fast to Hasan and Husayn. As for the shining stars, they are the nine Imams'

n0038.caption: The Prophet, Kifayat al-Athar, pp. 65-66, Salman's report, continued, p. 66
paragraphs: من صلب الحسين ، تاسعهم (1) مهديهم . ثم قال ﵇ : إنهم هم الأوصياء والخلفاء بعدي ، أئمة أبرار ، عدد أسباط يعقوب وحواري عيسى . قلت : فسمهم لي يا رسول الله ؟ قال : أولهم (2) علي بن أبي طالب ، وبعده (3) سبطاي ، وبعدهما علي (4) زين العابدين ، وبعده محمد بن علي الباقر (5) علم النبيين والصادق (6) جعفر بن محمد وابنه الكاظم سمي موسى بن عمران والذي يقتل بأرض الغربة (7) ابنه (8) علي ثم ابنه محمد (9) والصادقان علي والحسن والحجة القائم المنتظر في غيبته ،
from the loins of Husayn, the ninth of whom is their Mahdi."
Then he said, "They are the legatees and caliphs after me, righteous Imams, equal in number to the tribes of Yaqub and the apostles of Isa."
I said, "Name them for me, O Messenger of God."

He said, "The first of them is Ali ibn Abi Talib. After him are my two grandsons. After them are Ali Zayn al-Abidin, then Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir, the knowledge of the prophets, al-Sadiq Jafar ibn Muhammad, his son al-Kazim, the namesake of Musa ibn Imran, and the one who will be killed in the land of exile, his son Ali, then his son Muhammad, the two truthful ones Ali and Hasan, and the Proof, the Qa'im awaited during his occultation,"

n0041.caption: Imam al-Baqir, Tafsir al-Qummi, vol. 1, p. 365, Abu al-Jarud's report
paragraphs: ثم قص قصة يوسف لأبيه (يا أبت اني رأيت أحد عشر كوكبا والشمس والقمر رأيتهم لي ساجدين) حدثنا محمد بن جعفر قال حدثنا محمد بن أحمد قال حدثنا علي بن محمد عمن حدثه عن المنقري عن عمرو بن شمر عن إسماعيل السندي عن عبد الرحمن ابن سابط القرشي عن جابر بن عبد الله الأنصاري في قول الله ﷿ " اني رأيت أحد عشر كوكبا والشمس والقمر رأيتهم لي ساجدين " قال في تسمية النجوم هو الطارق وحوبان والذيال (الدبال ك) وذو الكتفين (ذو الكنفين ط) ووثاب وقابس وعمودان وفليق (فيلق) ومصبح والصرح والفروع (والقروع) والضياء والنور يعني الشمس والقمر وكل هذه النجوم محيطة بالسماء ، وفي رواية أبي الجارود عن أبي جعفر ﵇ قال تأويل هذه الرؤيا انه سيملك مصر ويدخل عليه أبواه واخوته ، اما الشمس فأم يوسف راحيل والقمر يعقوب واما أحد عشر كوكبا فاخوته ، فلما دخلوا عليه سجدوا شكرا لله وحده حين نظروا إليه وكان ذلك السجود لله .
Then he related Joseph's story to his father. "My father, I saw eleven stars, and the sun and the moon. I saw them prostrating themselves before me."

Muhammad ibn Ja'far narrated to us. He said that Muhammad ibn Ahmad narrated to us. He said that Ali ibn Muhammad narrated to us from one who narrated to him, from al-Minqari, from Amr ibn Shimr, from Isma'il al-Sindi, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Sabit al-Qurashi, from Jabir ibn Abd Allah al-Ansari, concerning the saying of God, "I saw eleven stars, and the sun and the moon. I saw them prostrating themselves before me."

He said concerning the names of the stars, "They are al-Tariq, Hawban, al-Dhiyal, al-Dibbal in K, Dhu al-Katifayn, Dhu al-Kanafayn in T, Waththab, Qabis, Amudan, Faliq, Faylaq, Musbih, al-Sarh, al-Furu', al-Quru' in the variant reading, al-Diya', and al-Nur, meaning the sun and the moon. All these stars surround the sky."

In the report of Abu al-Jarud from Abu Ja'far, he said, "The interpretation of this vision is that he will rule Egypt, and his parents and brothers will enter upon him. The sun was Joseph's mother Rachel, the moon was Jacob, and the eleven stars were his brothers. When they entered upon him, they prostrated in thanks to God alone when they saw him. That prostration was for God."

n0044.caption: Labib Baydun, Mawsu'at Karbala, vol. 1, p. 131
paragraphs: 45 - الإنجيل يتنبّأ بالأئمة الاثني عشر : جاء في الإصحاح الحادي عشر عن تنبؤات يوحنا اللاهوتي ما نصه : « وظهرت آية عظيمة في السماء ، امرأة متسربلة بالشمس ، وتحت رجليها القمر ، وعلى رأسها إكليل من اثني عشر كوكبا » . فكأنه يتكلم عن مولاتنا فاطمة الزهراء ﵍ وقد تسربلت بالشمس يعني أبيها محمّد ﵌ ، وتزوجت بالقمر وهو علي بن أبي طالب ﵇ ، وعلى رأسها إكليل من أبنائها المعصومين الاثني عشر ، الذين أولهم الحسن والحسين وآخرهم المهدي ﵇ . وليس هناك فيما تنبّأ به يوحنا اللاهوتي فيما سيحصل من أمور ، شيء شبيه بالذي ذكر ، غير فاطمة وأبيها وبعلها وبنيها ﵈ .
The Gospel foretells the twelve Imams.
In the eleventh chapter, the following occurs among the prophecies of John the Theologian.
"A great sign appeared in heaven, a woman clothed with the sun, with the moon beneath her feet, and on her head a crown of twelve stars."

It is as though he is speaking of our lady Fatima al-Zahra. She was clothed with the sun, meaning her father Muhammad, and married to the moon, who is Ali ibn Abi Talib. Upon her head is a crown from her twelve infallible sons, the first of whom are al-Hasan and al-Husayn and the last of whom is the Mahdi.
Among what John the Theologian foretold would occur, there is nothing resembling what he mentioned except Fatima, her father, her husband, and her sons.

n0046.caption: Al-Yazdi al-Ha'iri, Ilzam al-Nasib, vol. 1, pp. 129-130, p. 129
paragraphs: البشارة السابعة عشرة في قوام الأمة عن مكاشفات يوحنا في الباب الثاني عشر في الآية الأولى ما ترجمته : إنه ظهر في السماء علامة وهي امرأة لبست الشمس ، وتحت رجليها القمر ، وعلى رأسها تاج من اثني عشر كوكبا ، فبينما هي حامل وإذا بثعبان سيمتلئ ، وكل جبل وأكمة ستتضع وتعتدل المعوجات وتلين الصعاب ، تلك الكواكب على الأرض والثعبان واقفة عند المرأة الحاملة على الوضع لتأخذ مولودها بعد وضعها ، فوضعت ذكرا سويا يحكم على جميع الطوائف بعصا من حديد ، فاجتلب وأخذ إلى الله وبلغ إلى مقرره وسريره ، انتهى (2) . قال المؤلف : المراد بالامرأة هي فاطمة الزهراء حيث غلبت نورها الشمس ، والقمر تحت رجلها وهي أعلى وأجل ، بل نوره جزء من آلاف جزء من أجزاء نورها ومكتسب منها ، والتاج المشتمل على البروج الاثني عشر الأئمة الاثنا عشر سلام الله عليهم أجمعين ، والمراد من تلك الثعبان شجرة بني أمية ، الشجرة الخبيثة ، قتلت الكواكب المعنوية المشرقة ، والمراد من الطفل هو الإمام القائم (﵇) الغائب ، حيث أراد الأعداء قتله فاختفى وحجب عن الأبصار ، والعصا الحديد كناية عن السيف ، فيقاتل من على وجه الأرض من الطوائف بالسيف ويملأ الأرض قسطا وعدلا ويضمحل وينهدم بنيان الكفر والضلال والظلم ، وليس مراد اليسوع المسيح لأنه (﵇) لم يقاتل قط ، وإنما كان المسيح مظهرا للرحمة ، ويمكن أن يكون المراد من النجوم الاثني عشر محمدا (﵌) وعليا والعشرة من أولاده ، والقمر كناية عن القائم (﵇) ، ولا ينطبق على مريم واليسوع والحواريين ، لأنهم وإن كانوا اثني عشر إلا أنه ارتد واحد منهم فينافي العدد المعلوم .

The seventeenth glad tiding concerning the support of the community is from the Revelations of John, in chapter twelve, verse one. Its translation is as follows. "A sign appeared in heaven. It was a woman clothed with the sun, with the moon beneath her feet and a crown of twelve stars upon her head. While she was pregnant, behold, a serpent will be filled, and every mountain and hill will be lowered, the crooked places will be made straight, and the rough places will become smooth. Those stars are upon the earth, and the serpent stands before the woman who is pregnant and about to give birth, in order to take her child after she gives birth. So she gave birth to a sound male, who rules all the groups with an iron rod. He was carried away and taken to God, and reached His abode and throne." End.

The author said, "What is meant by the woman is Fatimah al-Zahra, for her light surpassed the sun. The moon is beneath her foot, and she is higher and more majestic. Indeed, its light is one part of thousands of parts of portions of her light and is acquired from her. The crown containing the twelve constellations is the twelve Imams, peace be upon them all. What is meant by that serpent is the tree of Banu Umayyah, the wicked tree. It killed the shining spiritual stars. What is meant by the child is the hidden Imam, the Qa'im. Since the enemies wanted to kill him, he concealed himself and was veiled from sight. The iron rod is a metaphor for the sword. He will fight the groups upon the face of the earth with the sword, fill the earth with equity and justice, and the structure of unbelief, error, and oppression will vanish and collapse. Jesus the Messiah is not meant, because he never fought. Rather, the Messiah was a manifestation of mercy. It is possible that the twelve stars mean Muhammad, Ali, and ten of his sons, and that the moon is a metaphor for the Qa'im. It does not apply to Mary, Jesus, and the disciples, because although they were twelve, one of them apostatized, which conflicts with the known number."

n0047.caption: Al-Yazdi al-Ha'iri, Ilzam al-Nasib, vol. 1, pp. 129-130, continued, p. 130
paragraphs: وما فسره بعض علماء النصارى من أن المراد من المرأة هي المعبد والكنيسة ، والنجوم الاثني عشر عبارة عن الحوراء الملازمة لها الحافات حولها ، وذلك حيث ذكر في الباب الثاني من المكاشفات أن اكتب للحوراء الموكلة بكنيسة أقس أن من بيده النجوم السبع يسير في المصابيح السبعة المذهبة ، ففيه أن الكنايس لا تشتمل على الحور ولا يناسب ذكر النجم لها أيضا وبعيد جدا ، والتعبير عن الخادم والحارث والحفظة مع ما هم عليه من الظلمة بالنورانية والبهاء أبعد خطأ عند العقلاء .

What some Christian scholars interpreted is that the woman means the temple and the church, and that the twelve stars refer to the maidens attached to her and surrounding her. This is because chapter two of the Apocalypse mentions, "Write to the maiden appointed over the church of Ephesus, that He who holds the seven stars walks among the seven golden lampstands." Yet churches do not contain maidens, nor is it fitting to call her a star. This is very far-fetched. Moreover, to describe the servant, the cultivator, and the guards, despite their darkness, as luminous and radiant is an even more erroneous mistake in the judgment of rational people.

n0053.caption: Genesis 17:20, Westminster Leningrad Codex, Van Dyck, King James Version
paragraphs: וּֽלְיִשְׁמָעֵאל֮ שְׁמַעְתִּיךָ֒ הִנֵּ֣ה ׀ בֵּרַ֣כְתִּי אֹתֹ֗ו וְהִפְרֵיתִ֥י אֹתֹ֛ו וְהִרְבֵּיתִ֥י אֹתֹ֖ו בִּמְאֹ֣ד מְאֹ֑ד שְׁנֵים־עָשָׂ֤ר נְשִׂיאִם֙ יֹולִ֔יד וּנְתַתִּ֖יו לְגֹ֥וי גָּדֹֽול׃
20 وأما إسماعيل فقد سمعت لك فيه . هاأنا أباركه وأثمره وأكثره كثيرا جدا . اثني عشر رئيسا يلد وأجعله أمة كبيرة
uleyishma'el shema'tikha, hinneh berakhtiv vehifreitiv vehirbeitiv bime'od me'od. sheneim-asar nesi'im yolid, unetativ legoy gadol.
"And as for Ishmael, I have heard thee: Behold, I have blessed him, and will make him fruitful, and will multiply him exceedingly; twelve princes shall he beget, and I will make him a great nation."

n0055.caption: Al-Nu'mani, Kitab al-Ghayba, p. 108, from a Jewish scholar of Arrajan
paragraphs: وقد أجبت دعاءك في إسماعيل ، وقد سمعتك ما باركته ، وسأكثره جدا جدا ، وسيلد اثني عشر عظيما أجعلهم أئمة كشعب عظيم . أقرأني عبد الحليم بن الحسين السمري (﵀) ما أملاه عليه رجل من اليهود بأرجان (1) يقال له الحسين بن سليمان من علماء اليهود بها من أسماء الأئمة (﵈) بالعبرانية وعدتهم ، وقد أثبته على لفظه ، وكان فيما قرأه أنه يبعث من ولد إسماعيل في التوراة اشموعيل يسمى مابد (2) يعني محمدا (﵌) يكون سيدا ، ويكون من آله اثنا عشر رجلا أئمة وسادة يقتدى بهم ، وأسماؤهم : تقوبيت ، فيذوا ، ذبيرا ، مفسورا ، مسموعا ، دوموه ، ثبو ، هذار ، يثمو ، بطور ، نوقس ، قيدموا .

"I have answered your prayer concerning Ishmael. I have heard you and blessed him. I shall multiply him exceedingly, exceedingly. He will father twelve great men, and I shall make them imams for a great people."

Abd al-Halim ibn al-Husayn al-Samuri read to me what a Jewish man in Arrajan, called al-Husayn ibn Sulayman, one of its Jewish scholars, dictated to him concerning the names of the imams in Hebrew and their number. I have recorded it in its own wording. Among what he read was that in the Torah, one will be sent from the descendants of Ishmael, called Ashmu'il, and named Mabad, meaning Muhammad. He will be a master, and from his family will be twelve men, imams and masters to be followed. Their names are Taqwabit, Fidhwa, Dhabira, Mafsura, Masmu'a, Dumuha, Thabu, Hadhar, Yathmu, Batur, Nuqus, and Qayduma.

n0057.caption: Al-Rawandi, al-Kharaij wa-l-Jara'ih, vol. 1, p. 77
paragraphs: منها ألفاظ التوراة في هذا الباب في السفر الأول منه : " إن الملك نزل على إبراهيم فقال له : إنه يولد في هذا العالم لك غلام اسمه إسحاق . فقال إبراهيم : ليت إسماعيل يعيش بين أيديك بخدمتك . فقال الله لإبراهيم : لك ذلك ، قد استجبت في إسماعيل ، وإني أبركه وآمنه وأعظمه بما استجبت فيه " . وتفسير هذا الحرف : محمد ﵌ [وفيه أيضا مكتوب : " وأما ابن الأمة فقد باركت عليه جدا جدا] (1) ويلد اثني عشر عظيما ، وأصيره لامة كثيرة " .
Among the words of the Torah on this subject, in its first book, are the following.

"The angel came down to Abraham and said to him, 'A boy named Isaac will be born to you in this world.' Abraham said, 'Would that Ishmael might live before You in Your service.' God said to Abraham, 'That shall be yours. I have answered you concerning Ishmael. I shall bless him, secure him, and make him great through what I have answered concerning him.'"

The interpretation of this word is Muhammad. It is also written in it, "As for the son of the slave woman, I have blessed him exceedingly, exceedingly. He will beget twelve great ones, and I shall make him into a great nation."

n0059.caption: Al-Suddi's tafsir, quoted in Bihar al-Anwar, vol. 36, p. 216, with Majlisi's own verification, p. 216
paragraphs: انطلق بإسماعيل وأمة حتى تنزله بيت التهامي - يعني مكة - فإني ناشر ذريته وجاعلهم ثقلا على من كفر بي ، وجاعل منهم نبيا عظيما ، ومظهره على الأديان ، وجاعل من ذريته اثني عشر عظيما ، وجاعل ذريته عدد نجوم السماء (5) . أقول : سمعت من جماعة من ثقات أهل الكتاب أنه موجود في توراتهم الآن " وليشمعيل شمعتيك هينه برختي اوتو وهيفريتي اوتو وهيبريتى (6) اوتو بماود ماود شنيم عاسار نسيئيم يوليدو نتيتو لكوى كدول " وسمعتهم يترجمونه هكذا : ومن إسماعيل أسمعتك أني باركت إياه وأوفرت إياه وأكثرت إياه في غاية الغاية اثني عشر رؤساء يولدون ، ووهبته قوما عظيما .

Set out with Ishmael and his mother until you bring them down to the house of the Tihamah, meaning Mecca. For I will spread his descendants abroad, make them a burden upon whoever disbelieves in Me, raise from them a great prophet, make him manifest over the religions, make twelve great ones from his descendants, and make his descendants as numerous as the stars of heaven.

I say, I heard from a group of trustworthy People of the Book that this is now found in their Torah. "Ule-Yishmael shematikha, hinneh berakhti oto, vehifreti oto vehirbeiti oto bimeod meod, shenem asar nesi'im yolid, netativ legoy gadol." I heard them translate it as follows. "And concerning Ishmael, I have heard you. Behold, I have blessed him, made him fruitful, and multiplied him exceedingly, exceedingly. Twelve chiefs will be born, and I have given him to a great people."

n0060.caption: Al-Suddi's tafsir, quoted in Bihar al-Anwar, vol. 36, p. 216, with Majlisi's own verification, continued, p. 216
paragraphs: أقول : الذي يظهر من الاخبار أن " مادماد " اسم محمد ﵌ بالعبرانية
I say that what appears from the reports is that "Madmad" is the Hebrew name of Muhammad.

n0062.caption: Bihar al-Anwar, vol. 21, pp. 317-318, from Ibn Tawus, Iqbal al-A'mal
paragraphs: فقال : رب صلى على محمد وآل محمد ، كما اجتبيتهم وأخلصتهم إخلاصا ، فأوحى ﷿ ليهنئك (1) كرامتي وفضلي عليك ، فإني صائر بسلالة محمد ومن اصطفيت معه منهم إلى قناة صلبك ، ومخرجهم منك ، ثم من بكرك إسماعيل ﵇ ، فأبشر يا إبراهيم فإني واصل صلواتك بصلواتهم ، ومتبع ذلك بركاتي وترحمي عليك وعليهم ، وجاعل حناني (2) وحجتي إلى الأمد المعدود واليوم الموعود الذي أرث فيه سمائي وأرضي ، وأبعث له خلقي بفصل قضائي (3) وإفاضة رحمتي وعدلي . قال : فلما سمع أصحاب رسول الله ﵌ ما أفضى إليه القوم من تلاوة ما تضمنت الجامعة والصحف الدارسة من نعت رسول الله ﵌ وصفة أهل بيته المذكورين معه بما هم به منه وبما شاهدوا من مكانتهم عنده ازداد القوم بذلك يقينا وإيمانا ، واستطيروا له فرحا . قال : ثم صار القوم إلى ما نزل على موسى ﵇ فألفوا في السفر الثاني من التوراة : إني باعث في الأميين من ولد إسماعيل رسولا أنزل عليه كتابي وأبعثه بالشريعة القيمة إلى جميع خلقي ، أوتيه حكمتي ، وأؤيده بملائكتي (4) وجنودي تكون ذريته من ابنة له مباركة باركتها ، ثم من شبلين لها كإسماعيل وإسحاق أصلين لشعبين عظيمين (5) أكثرهم جدا جدا ، يكون منهم اثنا عشر قيما ، أكمل بمحمد ﵌ وبما أرسله به من بلاغ وحكمة ديني وأختم به أنبيائي ورسلي ، فعلى محمد وأمته تقوم الساعة .
He said, "My Lord, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, as You have chosen them and made them wholly sincere."

Then the Most High revealed, "Let My honor and My favor upon you give you glad tidings. I shall bring the progeny of Muhammad and those whom I have chosen with him from among them to the channel of your loins. I shall bring them forth from you, then from your firstborn Ishmael. So rejoice, Abraham. I shall join your blessings to their blessings, and I shall follow that with My blessings and My mercy upon you and upon them. I shall make My tenderness and My proof endure until the numbered term and the promised day, when I inherit My heaven and My earth and raise My creatures for the decisive execution of My judgment and the outpouring of My mercy and justice."

He said that when the companions of the Messenger of God heard what the people had disclosed by reciting what the comprehensive book and the worn scrolls contained concerning the description of the Messenger of God and the description of his household, who were mentioned with him, concerning what they were to him and what they witnessed of their rank with Him, the people increased thereby in certainty and faith, and their joy over it soared.

He said that the people then turned to what had been sent down to Moses. In the second book of the Torah they found, "I shall send among the unlettered people, from the descendants of Ishmael, a messenger upon whom I shall send down My Book. I shall send him with the upright law to all My creatures. I shall give him My wisdom and support him with My angels and My troops. His descendants will be from a blessed daughter whom I have blessed, then from her two cubs, like Ishmael and Isaac, the roots of two great peoples. I shall multiply them exceedingly, exceedingly. Among them will be twelve guardians. Through Muhammad and the message and wisdom with which I send him, I shall complete My religion and seal My prophets and messengers with him. The Hour will come upon Muhammad and his community."

n0067.caption: Fatimah and Jabir, al-Kafi, vol. 1, pp. 575-576, hadith of the Tablet, p. 575
paragraphs: 3 - محمد بن يحيى ومحمد بن عبد الله ، عن عبد الله بن جعفر ، عن الحسن بن ظريف وعلي بن محمد ، عن صالح بن أبي حماد ، عن بكر بن صالح ، عن عبد الرحمن بن سالم ، عن أبي بصير ، عن أبي عبد الله ﵇ قال : قال أبي لجابر بن عبد الله الأنصاري إن لي إليك حاجة فمتى يخف عليك أن أخلو بك فأسألك عنها ، فقال له جابر : أي الأوقات أحببته فخلا به في بعض الأيام فقال له : يا جابر أخبرني عن اللوح الذي رأيته في يد أمي فاطمة ﵍ بنت رسول الله ﵌ وما أخبرتك به أمي أنه في ذلك اللوح مكتوب ؟ فقال جابر : أشهد بالله أني دخلت على أمك فاطمة ﵍ في حياة رسول الله ﵌ فهنيتها بولادة الحسين ورأيت في يديها لوحا أخضر ، ظننت أنه من زمرد ورأيت فيه كتابا أبيض ، شبه لون الشمس ، فقلت لها : بأبي وأمي يا بنت رسول الله ﵌ ما هذا اللوح ؟ فقالت : هذا لوح أهداه الله إلى رسول الله ﵌ فيه اسم أبي واسم بعلي واسم ابني واسم الأوصياء من ولدي وأعطانيه أبي ليبشرني بذلك ، قال جابر فأعطتنيه أمك فاطمة ﵍ فقرأته واستنسخته ، فقال له أبي : فهل لك يا جابر : أن تعرضه علي قال : نعم ، فمشى معه أبي إلى منزل جابر فأخرج صحيفة من رق (1) ، فقال : يا جابر انظر في كتابك لأقرأ [أنا] عليك ، فنظر جابر في نسخته فقرأه أبي فما خالف حرف حرفا ، فقال جابر : فأشهد بالله أني هكذا رأيته في اللوح مكتوبا . بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم هذا كتاب من الله العزيز الحكيم لمحمد نبيه ونوره وسفيره وحجابه ودليله نزل به الروح الأمين من عند رب العالمين ، عظم يا محمد أسمائي واشكر نعمائي ولا تجحد آلائي ، إني أنا الله إله إلا أنا قاصم الجبارين ومديل المظلومين وديان الدين ، إني أنا الله لا إله إلا أنا ، فمن رجا غير فضلي أو خاف غير عدلي ، عذبته عذابا لا أعذبه (2) أحدا من العالمين فإياي فاعبد وعلي فتوكل ، إني لم أبعث نبيا فأكملت أيامه وانقضت مدته إلا جعلت له وصيا وإني فضلتك على الأنبياء وفضلت وصيك على الأوصياء وأكرمتك بشبليك (3) وسبطيك حسن وحسين ، فجعلت حسنا معدن علمي ،

Muhammad ibn Yahya and Muhammad ibn Abd Allah narrated from Abd Allah ibn Ja'far, from al-Hasan ibn Zarif and Ali ibn Muhammad, from Salih ibn Abi Hammad, from Bakr ibn Salih, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Salim, from Abu Basir, from Abu Abd Allah, who said
My father said to Jabir ibn Abd Allah al-Ansari, "I have a need to ask of you. When would it be convenient for you for me to be alone with you and ask you about it?"
Jabir said to him, "Whenever you wish."

One day he was alone with him, and he said, "O Jabir, tell me about the tablet that you saw in the hand of my mother Fatima, daughter of the Messenger of God, and about what my mother told you was written on that tablet."

Jabir said, "I bear witness by God that I entered upon your mother Fatima during the lifetime of the Messenger of God and congratulated her on the birth of al-Husayn. I saw in her hands a green tablet, which I thought was made of emerald, and I saw on it white writing, like the color of the sun. I said to her, 'May my father and mother be sacrificed for you, O daughter of the Messenger of God, what is this tablet?'

"She said, 'This is a tablet that God gave as a gift to the Messenger of God. It contains the name of my father, the name of my husband, the name of my son, and the names of the trustees from among my descendants. My father gave it to me to bring me glad tidings through it.'
"Jabir said, 'Then your mother Fatima gave it to me, and I read it and copied it.'
"My father said to him, 'O Jabir, would you show it to me?'

"He said, 'Yes.' My father walked with him to Jabir's house, and he brought out a sheet of parchment. He said, 'O Jabir, look at your writing so that I may read it to you.' Jabir looked at his copy, and my father read it. Not one letter differed from another letter.
"Jabir said, 'I bear witness by God that this is how I saw it written on the tablet.'

In the name of God, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful. This is a writing from God, the Mighty, the Wise, to Muhammad, His prophet, His light, His messenger, His veil, and His guide. The Trustworthy Spirit brought it down from the Lord of the worlds.

Magnify My names, O Muhammad. Give thanks for My blessings, and do not deny My favors. I am God. There is no god but I. I crush the tyrants, grant victory to the oppressed, and judge on the Day of Judgment. I am God. There is no god but I. Whoever hopes for other than My grace or fears other than My justice, I will punish with a punishment by which I will punish no one among the worlds. So worship Me and rely upon Me.

I did not send a prophet whose days were completed and whose term came to an end without appointing for him a trustee. I favored you above the prophets, favored your trustee above the trustees, and honored you through your two grandsons and descendants, Hasan and Husayn. I made Hasan a repository of My knowledge,

n0068.caption: Fatimah and Jabir, al-Kafi, vol. 1, pp. 575-576, hadith of the Tablet, continued, p. 576
paragraphs: بعد انقضاء مدة أبيه وجعلت حسينا خازن وحيي وأكرمته بالشهادة وختمت له بالسعادة ، فهو أفضل من استشهد وأرفع الشهداء درجة ، جعلت كلمتي التامة معه وحجتي البالغة عنده ، بعترته أثيب وأعاقب ، أولهم علي سيد العابدين وزين أوليائي الماضين (1) وابنه شبه جده المحمود محمد الباقر علمي والمعدن لحكمتي سيهلك المرتابون في جعفر ، الراد عليه كالراد علي ، حق القول مني لأكرمن مثوى جعفر ولاسرنه في أشياعه وأنصاره وأوليائه ، أتيحت (2) بعده موسى فتنة عمياء حندس لان خيط فرضي لا ينقطع وحجتي لا تخفى وأن أوليائي يسقون بالكأس الأوفى ، من جحد واحدا منهم فقد جحد نعمتي ومن غير آية من كتابي فقد افترى علي ، ويل للمفترين الجاحدين عند انقضاء مدة موسى عبدي وحبيبي وخيرتي في علي وليي وناصري ومن أضع عليه أعباء النبوة وأمتحنه بالاضطلاع بها يقتله عفريت مستكبر يدفن في المدينة التي بناها العبد الصالح (3) إلى جنب شر خلقي حق القول مني لأسرنه بمحمد ابنه وخليفته من بعده ووارث علمه ، فهو معدن علمي وموضع سري وحجتي على خلقي لا يؤمن عبد به إلا جعلت الجنة مثواه وشفعته في سبعين من أهل بيته كلهم قد استوجبوا النار وأختم بالسعادة لابنه علي وليي وناصري والشاهد في خلقي وأميني علي وحيي ، أخرج منه الداعي إلى سبيلي والخازن لعلمي الحسن وأكمل ذلك بابنه " م ح م د " رحمة للعالمين ، عليه كمال موسى وبهاء عيسى وصبر أيوب فيذل أوليائي في زمانه وتتهادى رؤوسهم كما تتهادى رؤوس الترك والديلم فيقتلون ويحرقون ويكونون خائفين ، مرعوبين ، وجلين ، تصبغ الأرض بدمائهم ويفشو الويل والرنا في نسائهم أولئك أوليائي حقا ، بهم أدفع كل فتنة عمياء حندس وبهم أكشف الزلازل وأدفع الآصار والاغلال أولئك عليهم صلوات من ربهم ورحمة وأولئك هم المهتدون . قال عبد الرحمن بن سالم : قال أبو بصير : لو لم تسمع في دهرك ، إلا هذا الحديث لكفاك ، فصنه إلا عن أهله .

"after his father's term came to an end. I made Husayn the keeper of My revelation. I honored him with martyrdom and sealed his life with happiness. He is the best of those martyred and the martyr of the highest rank. I placed My complete word with him and My conclusive proof with him. Through his progeny I reward and punish.

The first of them is Ali, master of the worshippers and adornment of My former saints. His son is the likeness of his praiseworthy grandfather, Muhammad, the splitter open of My knowledge and the mine of My wisdom. Those who doubt concerning Jafar will perish. Whoever rejects him is like one who rejects Me. My word is binding that I will honor Jafar's dwelling place and make him happy through his followers, supporters, and friends.

After him Musa will face a blind, dark trial, because the thread of My obligation does not break, My proof is not concealed, and My saints are given the fullest cup to drink. Whoever denies one of them has denied My blessing. Whoever alters a verse of My Book has fabricated a lie against Me. Woe to the lying deniers when the term of Musa, My servant, beloved, and chosen one, comes to an end, concerning Ali, My friend and helper, upon whom I place the burdens of prophethood and whom I test by having him bear them. An arrogant demon will kill him. He will be buried in the city built by the righteous servant, beside the worst of My creatures.

My word is binding that I will make him happy through Muhammad, his son, his successor after him, and the heir to his knowledge. He is the repository of My knowledge, the place of My secret, and My proof over My creatures. No servant believes in him without My making Paradise his dwelling place and accepting his intercession for seventy members of his household, all of whom have deserved the Fire.

I will seal with happiness his son Ali, My friend and helper, the witness among My creatures, and My trustee over My revelation. From him I will bring forth the caller to My path and the keeper of My knowledge, Hasan. I will complete that through his son Mim Ha Mim Dal, a mercy to the worlds. He will have the perfection of Musa, the splendor of Isa, and the patience of Ayyub. My saints will be humiliated in his time. Their heads will be passed from hand to hand as the heads of the Turks and Daylamites are passed from hand to hand. They will be killed and burned. They will be afraid, terrified, and fearful. The earth will be stained with their blood, and wailing and lamentation will spread among their women. Those are truly My saints. Through them I repel every blind, dark trial. Through them I uncover earthquakes and repel burdens and shackles. Upon them are blessings and mercy from their Lord, and they are the rightly guided."
Abd al-Rahman ibn Salim said, "Abu Basir said, 'If you heard nothing in your lifetime except this report, it would be enough for you. So guard it except from those worthy of it.'"

n0071.caption: The Prophet, Kamal al-Din, p. 289, carried also by Uyun al-Akhbar, Ithbat al-Hudat, and Bihar
paragraphs: 4 - حدثنا علي بن أحمد ﵁ قال : حدثنا محمد بن أبي عبد الله الكوفي عن موسى بن عمران ، عن عمه الحسين بن يزيد ، عن الحسن بن علي بن أبي حمزة ، عن أبيه ، عن يحيى بن أبي القاسم ، عن الصادق جعفر بن محمد ، عن أبيه ، عن جده ﵈ قال : قال رسول الله ﵌ : الأئمة بعدي اثنا عشر أولهم علي بن أبي طالب وآخرهم القائم ، هم خلفائي وأوصيائي وأوليائي ، وحجج الله على أمتي بعدي ، المقر بهم مؤمن ، والمنكر لهم كافر (2) .

Ali ibn Ahmad narrated to us. He said that Muhammad ibn Abi Abd Allah al-Kufi narrated to us from Musa ibn Imran, from his uncle al-Husayn ibn Yazid, from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Abi Hamza, from his father, from Yahya ibn Abi al-Qasim, from al-Sadiq Ja'far ibn Muhammad, from his father, from his grandfather, who said

The Messenger of God said, "The Imams after me are twelve. The first of them is Ali ibn Abi Talib, and the last of them is al-Qa'im. They are my successors, my trustees, my friends, and God's proofs against my community after me. Whoever acknowledges them is a believer, and whoever denies them is an unbeliever."

n0074.caption: Al-Saduq, Kamal al-Din, pp. 97-98, Sunni-chained reports and his verdict
paragraphs: عهد إلينا نبينا ﵌ أنه يكون من بعده اثنا عشر خليفة بعدد نقباء بني إسرائيل . وقد أخرجت بعض طرق هذا الحديث في هذا الكتاب وبعضها في كتاب النص على الأئمة الاثني عشر ﵈ . بالإمامة . ونقل مخالفونا من أصحاب الحديث نقلا ظاهرا مستفيضا من حديث جابر بن سمرة ما حدثنا به أحمد بن محمد بن إسحاق الدينوري ، وكان من أصحاب الحديث قال : حدثني أبو بكر بن أبي داود (1) ، عن إسحاق بن إبراهيم ابن شاذان ، عن الوليد بن هشام ، عن محمد بن ذكوان (2) قال : حدثني أبي ، عن أبيه ، عن ابن سيرين ، عن جابر بن سمرة السوائي قال : كنا عند النبي ﵌ فقال : يلي هذه الأمة اثنا عشر ، قال : فصرخ الناس فلم أسمع ما قال : فقلت لأبي - وكان أقرب إلى رسول الله ﵌ مني : ما قال : رسول الله ﵌ ؟ فقال : قال : كلهم من قريش وكلهم لا يرى مثله . وقد أخرجت طرق هذا الحديث أيضا ، وبعضهم روى " اثنا عشر أميرا " ، وبعضهم روى " اثنا عشر خليفة " فدل ذلك على أن الاخبار التي في يد الامامية ، عن النبي ﵌ والأئمة ﵈ بذكر الأئمة الاثني عشر أخبار صحيحة (3) .

Our Prophet entrusted us that after him there would be twelve caliphs, equal in number to the nuqaba of the Children of Israel. I have presented some of the chains of this report in this book and some in the book on the designation of the twelve Imams to the Imamate.

Our opponents among the traditionists have transmitted widely and openly the report of Jabir ibn Samurah. Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Ishaq al-Dinawari, who was among the traditionists, narrated to us that Abu Bakr ibn Abi Dawud narrated to him from Ishaq ibn Ibrahim ibn Shadhan, from al-Walid ibn Hisham, from Muhammad ibn Dhakwan, who said that his father narrated to him from his father, from Ibn Sirin, from Jabir ibn Samurah al-Suwa'i, who said
We were with the Prophet when he said, "Twelve will rule this community."
The people cried out, and I did not hear what he said. I said to my father, who was closer to the Messenger of God than I was, "What did the Messenger of God say?"
He said, "He said that all of them are from Quraysh, and none of them will be seen to have his like."

I have also presented the chains of this report. Some of them narrated "twelve commanders," and some narrated "twelve caliphs." This indicates that the reports held by the Imamiyya from the Prophet and the Imams concerning the mention of the twelve Imams are sound reports.

n0076.caption: Imam al-Baqir, al-Kafi, vol. 1, p. 580
paragraphs: 10 - علي بن إبراهيم ، عن محمد بن عيسى بن عبيد ، عن محمد بن الفضيل ، عن أبي حمزة ، عن أبي جعفر ﵇ قال : إن الله أرسل محمدا ﵌ إلى الجن والإنس وجعل من بعده اثني عشر وصيا ، منهم من سبق ومنهم من بقي وكل وصي جرت به سنة والأوصياء الذين من بعد محمد ﵌ على سنة أوصياء عيسى وكانوا اثني عشر وكان أمير المؤمنين ﵇ على سنة المسيح .

Ali ibn Ibrahim, from Muhammad ibn Isa ibn Ubayd, from Muhammad ibn al-Fudayl, from Abu Hamzah, from Abu Jafar, who said, "Allah sent Muhammad to the jinn and humankind, and after him He appointed twelve trustees. Some of them have passed and some remain. Each trustee has had a pattern run through him. The trustees after Muhammad follow the pattern of the trustees of Jesus. They were twelve, and the Commander of the Faithful followed the pattern of the Messiah."

n0078.caption: Al-Hasan answering, al-Kafi, vol. 1, pp. 573-574
paragraphs: فالتفت أمير المؤمنين ﵇ إلى الحسن فقال : يا أبا محمد أجبه ، قال : فأجابه الحسن ﵇ فقال الرجل أشهد أن لا إله إلا الله ولم أزل أشهد بها وأشهد أن محمدا رسول الله ولم أزل أشهد بذلك وأشهد أنك وصي رسول الله ﵌ والقائم بحجته - وأشار إلى أمير المؤمنين - ولم أزل أشهد بها وأشهد أنك وصيه والقائم بحجته - وأشار إلى الحسن ﵇ - وأشهد أن الحسين بن علي وصي أخيه والقائم بحجته بعده وأشهد على علي بن الحسين أنه القائم بأمر الحسين بعده وأشهد على محمد بن علي أنه القائم بأمر علي بن الحسين وأشهد على جعفر بن محمد بأنه القائم بأمر محمد وأشهد على موسى أنه القائم بأمر جعفر بن محمد وأشهد على علي بن موسى أنه القائم بأمر موسى بن جعفر وأشهد على محمد بن علي أنه القائم بأمر علي ابن موسى وأشهد على علي بن محمد بأنه القائم بأمر محمد بن علي وأشهد على الحسن بن علي بأنه القائم بأمر علي بن محمد وأشهد على رجل من ولد الحسن لا يكنى ولا يسمى حتى يظهر أمره فيملاها عدلا كما ملئت جورا والسلام عليك يا أمير المؤمنين ورحمة الله وبركاته ، ثم قام فمضى ، فقال أمير المؤمنين : يا أبا محمد اتبعه فانظر أين يقصد فخرج الحسن بن علي ﵉ فقال : ما كان إلا أن وضع رجله خارجا من المسجد فما دريت أين أخذ من أرض الله ، فرجعت إلى أمير المؤمنين ﵇ فأعلمته ، فقال : يا أبا محمد أتعرفه ؟ قلت : الله ورسوله وأمير المؤمنين أعلم ، قال : هو الخضر ﵇ .
The Commander of the Faithful turned to al-Hasan and said, "O Abu Muhammad, answer him."

Al-Hasan answered him. The man said, "I bear witness that there is no god but Allah, and I have never ceased to bear witness to it. I bear witness that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah, and I have never ceased to bear witness to that. I bear witness that you are the trustee of the Messenger of Allah and the one who upholds his proof," and he pointed to the Commander of the Faithful. "I have never ceased to bear witness to it. I bear witness that you are his trustee and the one who upholds his proof," and he pointed to al-Hasan. "I bear witness that al-Husayn ibn Ali is the trustee of his brother and the one who upholds his proof after him. I bear witness concerning Ali ibn al-Husayn that he is the one who upholds the affair of al-Husayn after him. I bear witness concerning Muhammad ibn Ali that he is the one who upholds the affair of Ali ibn al-Husayn. I bear witness concerning Jafar ibn Muhammad that he is the one who upholds the affair of Muhammad. I bear witness concerning Musa that he is the one who upholds the affair of Jafar ibn Muhammad. I bear witness concerning Ali ibn Musa that he is the one who upholds the affair of Musa ibn Jafar. I bear witness concerning Muhammad ibn Ali that he is the one who upholds the affair of Ali ibn Musa. I bear witness concerning Ali ibn Muhammad that he is the one who upholds the affair of Muhammad ibn Ali. I bear witness concerning al-Hasan ibn Ali that he is the one who upholds the affair of Ali ibn Muhammad. I bear witness concerning a man from the descendants of al-Hasan, who is neither given a kunyah nor named until his affair appears, and he will fill it with justice as it has been filled with tyranny. Peace be upon you, Commander of the Faithful, and Allah's mercy and blessings."
Then he rose and left. The Commander of the Faithful said, "O Abu Muhammad, follow him and see where he is going."
Al-Hasan ibn Ali went out and said, "As soon as he put his foot outside the mosque, I did not know where in Allah's earth he had gone."
I returned to the Commander of the Faithful and informed him. He said, "O Abu Muhammad, do you know him?"
I said, "Allah, His Messenger, and the Commander of the Faithful know best."
He said, "He is al-Khidr."

n0082.caption: The Prophet, Sahih Muslim, Kitab al-Imara, Jabir ibn Samura's reports
paragraphs: حدثنا قتيبة بن سعيد حدثنا جرير عن حصين عن جابر بن سمرة قال سمعت النبي ﵌ يقول ح وحدثنا رفاعة بن الهيثم الواسطي (واللفظ له) حدثنا خالد (يعنى ابن عبد الله الطحان) عن حصين عن جابر بن سمرة قال دخلت مع أبي على النبي ﵌ فسمعته يقول إن هذا الامر لا ينقضي حتى يمضى فيهم اثنا عشر خليفة قال ثم تكلم بكلام خفى على قال فقلت لأبي ما قال قال كلهم من قريش حدثنا ابن أبي عمر حدثنا سفيان عن عبد الملك بن عمير عن جابر بن سمرة قال سمعت النبي ﵌ يقول لا يزال امر الناس ماضيا ما وليهم اثنا عشر رجلا ثم تكلم النبي ﷺ بكلمة خفيت على فسألت أبى ماذا قال رسول الله ﷺ فقال كلهم من قريش
Qutaybah ibn Sa'id narrated to us. Jarir narrated to us from Husayn, from Jabir ibn Samurah, who said, "I heard the Prophet say."

It was also narrated to us by Rifa'ah ibn al-Haytham al-Wasiti, and this is his wording. Khalid, meaning Ibn Abd Allah al-Tahhan, narrated to us from Husayn, from Jabir ibn Samurah, who said, "I entered with my father upon the Prophet, and I heard him say, 'This matter will not end until twelve caliphs have passed among them.' He then spoke words that were indistinct to me. I said to my father, 'What did he say?' He said, 'All of them are from Quraysh.'"

Ibn Abi Umar narrated to us. Sufyan narrated to us from Abd al-Malik ibn Umayr, from Jabir ibn Samurah, who said, "I heard the Prophet say, 'The affairs of the people will continue as long as twelve men rule them.' Then the Prophet spoke a word that was indistinct to me, so I asked my father, 'What did the Messenger of God say?' He said, 'All of them are from Quraysh.'"

n0084.caption: Ibn Mas'ud's report, Musnad Ahmad, vol. 1, p. 398
paragraphs: (33) حدثنا عبد اللّه ، حدثني أبي ، ثنا حسن بن موسى ، ثنا حماد بن زيد عن المجالد ، عن الشعبي ، عن مسروق ، قال : كنا جلوسا عند عبد اللّه بن مسعود ، - وهو يقرئنا القرآن - ، فقال له رجل : يا أبا عبد الرحمن هل سألتم رسول اللّه ﵆ كم تملك هذه الأمة من خليفة ؟ فقال عبد اللّه بن مسعود : ما سألني عنها أحد منذ قدمت العراق قبلك ، ثم قال : نعم ، ولقد سألنا رسول اللّه ﵆ فقال : اثنا عشر ، كعدّة نقباء (1) بني إسرائيل . 1 / 398
(33) Abd Allah told us. My father told me. Hasan ibn Musa told us. Hammad ibn Zayd told us, from Mujalid, from al-Sha'bi, from Masruq, who said
We were sitting with Abd Allah ibn Mas'ud while he was teaching us the Quran. A man said to him, "Abu Abd al-Rahman, did you ask the Messenger of God how many caliphs will rule this community?"

Abd Allah ibn Mas'ud said, "No one has asked me about it before you since I came to Iraq." Then he said, "Yes, we did ask the Messenger of God, and he said, 'Twelve, equal to the number of the nuqaba of the Children of Israel.'"
Musnad, volume 1, page 398

n0086.caption: The Prophet, Sunan Abi Dawud, vol. 4, p. 175, report 4282
paragraphs: (4282) - حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ عُبَيْدٍ حَدَّثَهُمْ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلَاءِ ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ - يَعْنِي : ابْنَ عَيَّاشٍ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى ، أَخْبَرَنَا زَائِدَةُ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، حَدَّثَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى ، عَنْ فِطْرٍ - الْمَعْنَى - وَاحِدٌ ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ عَاصِمٍ ، عَنْ زِرٍّ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ : « لَوْ لَمْ يَبْقَ مِنْ الدُّنْيَا إِلَّا يَوْمٌ » - قَالَ زَائِدَةُ فِي حَدِيثِهِ : « لَطَوَّلَ اللَّهُ ذَلِكَ الْيَوْمَ » - ثُمَّ اتَّفَقُوا : « حَتَّى يَبْعَثَ فِيهِ رَجُلًا مِنِّي أَوْ مِنْ أَهْلِ بَيْتِي يُوَاطِئُ اسْمُهُ اسْمِي وَاسْمُ أَبِيهِ اسْمُ أَبِي زَادَ فِي حَدِيثِ فِطْرٍ : « يَمْلَأُ الْأَرْضَ قِسْطًا وَعَدْلًا كَمَا مُلِئَتْ ظُلْمًا وَجَوْرًا » - وَقَالَ فِي حَدِيثِ سُفْيَانَ : « لَا تَذْهَبُ أَوْ لَا تَنْقَضِي الدُّنْيَا حَتَّى يَمْلِكَ الْعَرَبَ رَجُلٌ مِنْ أَهْلِ بَيْتِي يُوَاطِئُ اسْمُهُ اسْمِي » . قَالَ أَبُو دَاوُد : لَفْظُ عُمَرَ وَأَبِي بَكْرٍ بِمَعْنَى سُفْيَانَ .

(4282) Musaddad narrated to us that Umar ibn Ubayd narrated to them. Muhammad ibn al-Ala narrated to us. Abu Bakr, meaning Ibn Ayyash, narrated to us. Musaddad narrated to us. Yahya narrated to us, from Sufyan. Ahmad ibn Ibrahim narrated to us. Ubayd Allah ibn Musa narrated to us. Za'idah informed us. Ahmad ibn Ibrahim narrated to us. Ubayd Allah ibn Musa narrated to me, from Fitr. The meaning is one. All of them narrated from Asim, from Zirr, from Abd Allah, from the Prophet, who said, "Even if only one day remained of this world," Za'idah said in his report, "Allah would lengthen that day," then they agreed, "until He sends in it a man from me or from my Household, whose name corresponds to my name and whose father's name corresponds to my father's name." Fitr added in his report, "He will fill the earth with equity and justice as it has been filled with oppression and tyranny."
Sufyan said in his report, "The world will not pass away, or will not come to an end, until a man from my Household whose name corresponds to my name rules the Arabs."
Abu Dawud said, "The wording of Umar and Abu Bakr has the same meaning as that of Sufyan."

n0089.caption: Al-Nawawi, Sharh Sahih Muslim, vol. 12, pp. 200-201
paragraphs: قوله (﵌) (أن هذا الأمر لا ينقضي حتى يمضي فيهم اثنا عشر خليفة كلهم من قريش) وفي رواية لا يزال أمر الناس ماضيا ما وليهم اثنا عشر رجلا كلهم من قريش [وفي رواية لا يزال الإسلام عزيزا إلى اثنى عشر خليفة كلهم من قريش قال القاضي قد توجه هنا سؤالان أحدهما أنه قد جاء في الحديث الآخر الخلافة بعدي ثلاثون سنة ثم تكون ملكا وهذا مخالف لحديث اثنى عشر خليفة فإنه لم يكن في ثلاثين سنة إلا الخلفاء الراشدون الأربعة والأشهر التي بويع فيها الحسن بن علي قال والجواب عن هذا أن المراد في حديث الخلافة ثلاثون سنة خلافة النبوة وقد جاء مفسرا في بعض الروايات خلافة النبوة بعدي ثلاثون سنة ثم تكون ملكا ولم يشترط هذا في الاثني عشر السؤال الثاني أنه قد ولى أكثر من هذا العدد قال وهذا اعتراض باطل لأنه (﵌) لم يقل لا يلي إلا اثنى عشر خليفة وإنما قال يلي وقد ولي هذا العدد ولا يضر كونه وجد بعدهم غيرهم

His statement, "This matter will not end until twelve caliphs have passed among them, all of them from Quraysh." In one version, "The affairs of the people will continue as long as twelve men rule them, all of them from Quraysh." In another version, "Islam will remain mighty until twelve caliphs, all of them from Quraysh."

Al-Qadi said that two questions arise here. The first is that another report states, "The caliphate after me will last thirty years, then there will be kingship." This conflicts with the report of twelve caliphs, for within thirty years there were only the four Rightly Guided Caliphs and the months during which Hasan ibn Ali received allegiance.

He said that the answer is that the caliphate meant in the report of thirty years is the caliphate of prophethood. This is explained in some versions, "The caliphate of prophethood after me will last thirty years, then there will be kingship." This was not stipulated regarding the twelve.

The second question is that more than this number have ruled. He said that this objection is invalid, because he did not say that only twelve caliphs would rule. Rather, he said that they would rule. This number has ruled, and it does not matter that others were found after them.

n0091.caption: Ibn Abbas's rebuke, Kanz al-Ummal, vol. 14, entry 39657
paragraphs: 39657 عن سعيد بن جبير قال : سمعنا ابن عباس ونحن نقول : اثنا عشر أميرا ثم لا أمير ، واثنا عشر أميرا ثم هي الساعة ، فقال : ما أحمقكم ! إن منا أهل البيت بعد ذلك : المنصور والسفاح والمهدي يدفعها إلى عيسى ابن مريم (كر) .

Sa'id ibn Jubayr said, "We heard Ibn Abbas while we were saying, 'Twelve commanders, then no commander. Twelve commanders, then the Hour.' He said, 'How foolish you are. After that, among us, the people of the House, are al-Mansur, al-Saffah, and al-Mahdi. He will hand it over to Jesus son of Mary.'"

n0095.caption: Isaiah 11:1-9, Westminster Leningrad Codex, Van Dyck, King James Version
paragraphs: וְיָצָ֥א חֹ֖טֶר מִגֵּ֣זַע יִשָׁ֑י וְנֵ֖צֶר מִשָּׁרָשָׁ֥יו יִפְרֶֽה׃ וְנָחָ֥ה עָלָ֖יו ר֣וּחַ יְהוָ֑ה ר֧וּחַ חָכְמָ֣ה וּבִינָ֗ה ר֤וּחַ עֵצָה֙ וּגְבוּרָ֔ה ר֥וּחַ דַּ֖עַת וְיִרְאַ֥ת יְהוָֽה׃ וַהֲרִיחֹ֖ו בְּיִרְאַ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה וְלֹֽא־לְמַרְאֵ֤ה עֵינָיו֙ יִשְׁפֹּ֔וט וְלֹֽא־לְמִשְׁמַ֥ע אָזְנָ֖יו יֹוכִֽיחַ׃ וְשָׁפַ֤ט בְּצֶ֙דֶק֙ דַּלִּ֔ים וְהֹוכִ֥יחַ בְּמִישֹׁ֖ור לְעַנְוֵי־אָ֑רֶץ וְהִֽכָּה־אֶ֙רֶץ֙ בְּשֵׁ֣בֶט פִּ֔יו וּבְר֥וּחַ שְׂפָתָ֖יו יָמִ֥ית רָשָֽׁע׃ וְהָ֥יָה צֶ֖דֶק אֵזֹ֣ור מָתְנָ֑יו וְהָאֱמוּנָ֖ה אֵזֹ֥ור חֲלָצָֽיו׃ וְגָ֤ר זְאֵב֙ עִם־כֶּ֔בֶשׂ וְנָמֵ֖ר עִם־גְּדִ֣י יִרְבָּ֑ץ וְעֵ֨גֶל וּכְפִ֤יר וּמְרִיא֙ יַחְדָּ֔ו וְנַ֥עַר קָטֹ֖ן נֹהֵ֥ג בָּֽם׃ וּפָרָ֤ה וָדֹב֙ תִּרְעֶ֔ינָה יַחְדָּ֖ו יִרְבְּצ֣וּ יַלְדֵיהֶ֑ן וְאַרְיֵ֖ה כַּבָּקָ֥ר יֹֽאכַל־תֶּֽבֶן׃ וְשִֽׁעֲשַׁ֥ע יֹונֵ֖ק עַל־חֻ֣ר פָּ֑תֶן וְעַל֙ מְאוּרַ֣ת צִפְעֹונִ֔י גָּמ֖וּל יָדֹ֥ו הָדָֽה׃ לֹֽא־יָרֵ֥עוּ וְלֹֽא־יַשְׁחִ֖יתוּ בְּכָל־הַ֣ר קָדְשִׁ֑י כִּֽי־מָלְאָ֣ה הָאָ֗רֶץ דֵּעָה֙ אֶת־יְהוָ֔ה כַּמַּ֖יִם לַיָּ֥ם מְכַסִּֽים׃ פ

1 ويخرج قضيب من جذع يسى وينبت غصن من أصوله 2 ويحل عليه روح الرب روح الحكمة والفهم روح المشورة والقوة روح المعرفة ومخافة الرب . 3 ولذته تكون في مخافة الرب فلا يقضي بحسب نظر عينيه ولا يحكم بحسب سمع أذنيه . 4 بل يقضي بالعدل للمساكين ويحكم بالإنصاف لبائسي الأرض ويضرب الأرض بقضيب فمه ويميت المنافق بنفخة شفتيه . 5 ويكون البر منطقة متنيه والأمانة منطقة حقويه 6 فيسكن الذئب مع الخروف ويربض النمر مع الجدي والعجل والشبل والمسمن معا وصبي صغير يسوقها . 7 والبقرة والدبة ترعيان . تربض أولادهما معا والأسد كالبقر يأكل تبنا . 8 ويلعب الرضيع على سرب الصل ويمد الفطيم يده على حجر الأفعوان . 9 لا يسوؤون ولا يفسدون في كل جبل قدسي لأن الأرض تمتلئ من معرفة الرب كما تغطي المياه البحر

vayyetse ḥoter migezaʿ yishay, venetser mishorašav yifreh. venāḥah alav ruaḥ YHWH, ruaḥ ḥokhmah uvinah, ruaḥ ʿeṣah ugvurah, ruaḥ daʿat viyirʾat YHWH. vahariḥo viyirʾat YHWH, velo-leyʿeynav yishpot, velo-leʾoznav yokhiʾaḥ. veshafat betzedek dalim, vehokhiʾaḥ bemishor leʿanvei-ʾareṣ, vehikah ʾareṣ beshivet pi, uveruaḥ sfatav yamit rashaʿ. vehayah tzedek ezor motnav, vehaʾemunah ezor ḥalatsav. vegar zeev ʿim-keves, venamer ʿim-gedi yarbetseḥ, veʿegel uchefar vameri yakhad, venaʿar qaton noheg bam. uparah udov tirʾeynah, yakhad yirbetseḥ yaldeihen, vearyah kabbakar yoḥal teven. veshiʿashuaʿ yoneq ʿal-ḥor faten, veʿal-meʾurat tzifʿoni gamul yado hedah. Lo-yareʾu velo-yashḥitu bekhol har kodshi, ki-maleʾah haʾareṣ deʿat ʾet-YHWH, kamayim layam mekhassim.

"And there shall come forth a rod out of the stem of Jesse, and a Branch shall grow out of his roots: And the spirit of the LORD shall rest upon him, the spirit of wisdom and understanding, the spirit of counsel and might, the spirit of knowledge and of the fear of the LORD; And shall make him of quick understanding in the fear of the LORD: and he shall not judge after the sight of his eyes, neither reprove after the hearing of his ears: But with righteousness shall he judge the poor, and reprove with equity for the meek of the earth: and he shall smite the earth with the rod of his mouth, and with the breath of his lips shall he slay the wicked. And righteousness shall be the girdle of his loins, and faithfulness the girdle of his reins. The wolf also shall dwell with the lamb, and the leopard shall lie down with the kid; and the calf and the young lion and the fatling together; and a little child shall lead them. And the cow and the bear shall feed; their young ones shall lie down together: and the lion shall eat straw like the ox. And the sucking child shall play on the hole of the asp, and the weaned child shall put his hand on the cockatrice' den. They shall not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain: for the earth shall be full of the knowledge of the LORD, as the waters cover the sea."

paragraphs: לִשְׁלֹמֹ֨ה ׀ אֱ‍ֽלֹהִ֗ים מִ֭שְׁפָּטֶיךָ לְמֶ֣לֶךְ תֵּ֑ן וְצִדְקָתְךָ֥ לְבֶן־מֶֽלֶךְ׃ יָדִ֣ין עַמְּךָ֣ בְצֶ֑דֶק וַעֲנִיֶּ֥יךָ בְמִשְׁפָּֽט׃ יִשְׂא֤וּ הָרִ֓ים שָׁ֘לֹ֥ום לָעָ֑ם וּ֝גְבָעֹ֗ות בִּצְדָקָֽה׃ יִשְׁפֹּ֤ט ׀ עֲ‍ֽנִיֵּי־עָ֗ם יֹ֭ושִׁיעַ לִבְנֵ֣י אֶבְיֹ֑ון וִֽידַכֵּ֣א עֹושֵֽׁק׃ יִֽירָא֥וּךָ עִם־שָׁ֑מֶשׁ וְלִפְנֵ֥י יָ֝רֵ֗חַ דֹּ֣ור דֹּורִֽים׃ יֵ֭רֵד כְּמָטָ֣ר עַל־גֵּ֑ז כִּ֝רְבִיבִ֗ים זַרְזִ֥יף אָֽרֶץ׃ יִֽפְרַח־בְּיָמָ֥יו צַדִּ֑יק וְרֹ֥ב שָׁלֹום עַד־בְּלִ֥י יָרֵֽחַ׃ וְ֭יֵרְדְּ מִיָּ֣ם עַד־יָ֑ם וּ֝מִנָּהָ֗ר עַד־אַפְסֵי־אָֽרֶץ׃

"A Psalm for Solomon. Give the king thy judgments, O God, and thy righteousness unto the king's son. He shall judge thy people with righteousness, and thy poor with judgment. The mountains shall bring peace to the people, and the little hills, by righteousness. He shall judge the poor of the people, he shall save the children of the needy, and shall break in pieces the oppressor. They shall fear thee as long as the sun and moon endure, throughout all generations. He shall come down like rain upon the mown grass: as showers that water the earth. In his days shall the righteous flourish; and abundance of peace so long as the moon endureth. He shall have dominion also from sea to sea, and from the river unto the ends of the earth."

n0098.caption: Daniel 7:13-14, Westminster Leningrad Codex, Van Dyck, King James Version
paragraphs: חָזֵ֤ה הֲוֵית֙ בְּחֶזְוֵ֣י לֵֽילְיָ֔א וַאֲרוּ֙ עִם־עֲנָנֵ֣י שְׁמַיָּ֔א כְּבַ֥ר אֱנָ֖שׁ אָתֵ֣ה הֲוָ֑ה וְעַד־עַתִּ֤יק יֹֽומַיָּא֙ מְטָ֔ה וּקְדָמֹ֖והִי הַקְרְבֽוּהִי׃ וְלֵ֨הּ יְהִ֤יב שָׁלְטָן֙ וִיקָ֣ר וּמַלְכ֔וּ וְכֹ֣ל עַֽמְמַיָּ֗א אֻמַיָּ֛א וְלִשָּׁנַיָּ֖א לֵ֣הּ יִפְלְח֑וּן שָׁלְטָנֵ֞הּ שָׁלְטָ֤ן עָלַם֙ דִּֽי־לָ֣א יֶעְדֵּ֔ה וּמַלְכוּתֵ֖הּ דִּי־לָ֥א תִתְחַבַּֽל׃ פ

13 كنت أرى في رؤى الليل وإذا مع سحب السماء مثل ابن إنسان أتى وجاء إلى القديم الأيام فقربوه قدامه . 14 فأعطي سلطانا ومجدا وملكوتا لتتعبد له كل الشعوب والأمم والألسنة . سلطانه سلطان أبدي ما لن يزول وملكوته ما لا ينقرض

ḥazeh havet beḥezvei leilya, weʾaru ʿim ʿananei shemaya kevar ʾenaš ʾatah havah, weʿad ʿatiq yomaya metaḥ, weqadmohi heqerbuhi. Uleh yehiv sheltan, veʾiqar, umalkhu, veḥol ʿammayya ʾummayya velishshanaya lehu yipelḥun, sheltaneih sheltan ʿalam di-lo yeʿdeh, umalkhuteih di-lo tithabal.

"I saw in the night visions, and, behold, one like the Son of man came with the clouds of heaven, and came to the Ancient of days, and they brought him near before him. And there was given him dominion, and glory, and a kingdom, that all people, nations, and languages, should serve him: his dominion is an everlasting dominion, which shall not pass away, and his kingdom that which shall not be destroyed."
